name: Shenzhen Transsion Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Transsion Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides smart devices and mobile internet services in Africa, South Asia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Latin America, and internationally.
